counterfactual_missing_items: R1 lacks any explanation for the separate parietal bone lesion
R1 does not account for bilateral semicircular canal involvement
decisive_items: bilateral osteolysis of the mastoids, superior and lateral semicircular canals, and the right external auditory canal
separate osteolytic lesion in the dorsal left parietal bone
response.rationale: R2 explains the full distribution of lytic bone lesions including the separate parietal lesion, which is characteristic of Langerhans cell histiocytosis. R1 (cholesteatoma) cannot account for the distant parietal lesion or bilateral semicircular canal destruction, making R2 the superior diagnosis.

rejected.why: C1 is an append-only completion of R2 with no new raw support; it is a correlated restatement and should be discounted.
